title: Obfuscated Folly
description: Adds a new Obfuscation enchantment to Minecraft!
body:
# **IMPORTANT**
YOU NEED THE TRAILIER TRAILS MOD FOR THIS DATAPACK TO WORK, GET THE MOD [HERE](https://modrinth.com/mod/trailier-tales)
##  **INTRO**
This pack was just a small side project I make in like 30 minutes. I was playing with the [Trailier Trails](https://modrinth.com/mod/trailier-tales) mod and I found effect called **Haunt** what this effect does is block out your hearts/armour/hunger and makes its impossible to know when you are about to die! I found this realy interesting so i make this datapack.

## **OBFUSCATE**
This is a axe enchantment and enflics the Haunt Effect for 5s which makes it so the effect entity cant see their health or hunger.

## **MAIN USE CASE**
What I made this datapack for original was to use it in PvP by disabling my opponent's HUD but you can use it for anything you want!

## **INFO FOR CREATORS**
If you do want to use this datapack in a modpack feel free! (I say this like this pack is gonna get like 1 Million downloads)
